articles.summary: Long-term agreement extends Versant’s distribution partnership with Verizon across its leading news, sports and entertainment portfolio NEW YORK --(BUSINESS WIRE)--Oct. 2, 2026-- Versant (Nasdaq: VSNT) today announced it has reached a multi-year renewal of their distribution agreement with Verizon.
articles.title: Versant Reaches Multi-Year Distribution Renewal Agreement With Verizon
